payload.claim: Several saffron/task.py line citations the spec relies on to locate required edits are stale and point at the wrong code at this snapshot. `saffron/task.py:931-934` (cited for `outcome.rebut_result is None`) is actually at line 958; the EXHAUSTED push/QueueLine block cited at `:995-1011` actually runs from roughly 1022-1038; the two `QueueLine` call sites cited at `:1009-1010` and `:1052-1053` (two of the Context section's 'three sites' that criterion 8 requires carry the new counts) are actually at 1036-1037 and 1079-1080; and `ready_task`'s `CellOutcome(...)` construction, cited at `:1373-1387` for criterion 9, is actually at roughly 1400-1413. All five are off by the same ~27 lines, caused by SA-0338 (commit fd36d390) inserting a mutants_commit lookup block into task.py before line 900. Commit c4149fbd explicitly re-pointed sibling specs SA-0341, SA-0343 and SA-0352-0354 for this exact shift ('citations moved when SA-0338 and SA-0339 landed') but did not include SA-0340, and the later commit bcaa751e only rewrote this spec's 'read at `c8e8f6e6`' attribution sentence without correcting the stale numbers underneath it. A related instance: the second hand-built CellOutcome stand-in the Notes section cites at `tests/test_session.py:13869-13890` (needing `unread=0, unanswered=0` added) is actually the SimpleNamespace at roughly 13900-13921, off by the ~31 lines SA-0338 added to that file. A cell that anchors its edits to these literal ranges risks inserting the new fields/counts in the wrong place in task.py (e.g. into the exception handler of `run_one_cell`, or into `_fallback_parent_branch`'s resolution logic, rather than the exhausted-package QueueLine or `ready_task`'s CellOutcome build), or missing the second stand-in fixture in test_session.py, producing a wrong build of criteria 8 and 9 and risking an AttributeError in a test criterion 6's fixture should also cover.
